name: WdExportCreateBookmarks
description: Specifies what bookmarks to include when exporting a document.

constants.name: wdExportCreateNoBookmarks
constants.description: Do not create bookmarks in the exported document.

constants.name: wdExportCreateHeadingBookmarks
constants.description: Create a bookmark in the exported document for each Microsoft Word heading, which includes only headings within the main document and text boxes not within headers, footers, endnotes, footnotes, or comments.

constants.name: wdExportCreateWordBookmarks
constants.description: Create a bookmark in the exported document for each Word bookmark, which includes all bookmarks except those contained within headers and footers.
